rows.label: qst650615_msg0002
rows.name:
Look, look!
The Linka Honey finally arrived!

rows.label: qst650615_msg0003
rows.name:
And the merchant said
you'd already paid for it[ML:Dash ]

rows.label: qst650615_msg0006
rows.name:
I was so happy, I used every
big pot in the inn to make
a whole lot of curry!

rows.label: qst650615_msg0007
rows.name: How did you manage the heat?

rows.label: qst650615_msg0009
rows.name: So it'll be all right now, won't it?

rows.label: qst650615_msg0010
rows.name:
I can go and see my father now,
can't I?!

rows.label: qst650615_msg0011
rows.name:
Of course. That's why
you worked so hard on the curry.

rows.label: qst650615_msg0012
rows.name:
You've made everyone happy
with your curry. Now it's time
for you to find happiness.

rows.label: qst650615_msg0013
rows.name:
The last place we saw Lazaro-san
was the old quarry, right?
